name: gingaf-node
description: Node.js middleware and static asset distribution package for GingaF Flutter Web

scripts.flutter:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if (!fs.existsSync('../ginga/build/web/index.html')) cp.execSync('cd ../ginga && flutter build web --release', { stdio: 'inherit' }); else console.log('Flutter web build exists, skipping build.');"
scripts.build: npm run flutter:build && npm run copy:assets && tsc
